map.第三强度理论（最大剪应力）对塑性材料，当量应力 σe=√(σ²+3τ²)，保守且: The third strength theory (maximum shear stress) for ductile materials gives the equivalent stress σe=√(σ²+3τ²), conservative and commonly used in engineering.
